input.description: Telemetry shows oil pressure steadily declining from 35.7 psi to ~18-19 psi over ~90 minutes while RPM (1600-1700), coolant temp (~88-90°C), and coolant level (96%) remained stable and normal — indicating a genuine progressive oil pressure loss rather than a sensor glitch or thermal/load artifact. KB-004 (the only matching entry) describes this exact pattern as "low oil pressure warning, not resolved by sensor restart," with known fix schedule_service_visit; no conflicting KB entries were found. Service history shows the oil pressure sensor was already replaced in March for an unrelated fault, making a recurring sensor fault less likely as the primary cause. Given the sustained, stabilized low reading and the KB guidance, a service visit to inspect the oil pump/lines/filter is recommended rather than a sensor restart.
